messages.威力の大半をコイン威力に頼る、精神力しだいの貫通アタッカー。精神力を高く保ってマ: A Pierce attacker whose Power comes mainly from Coin Power, making SP crucial. Maintain high SP to win clashes, then press the advantage with the 3-Coin S3 For Justice! At Uptie Ⅳ, she can also stack Bleed.
messages.コイン威力への依存: S1「刺す」は基本威力2〜4にコイン威力+7、S2「束ね刺: **Reliance on Coin Power**: S1 Joust has 2–4 Base Power with +7 Coin Power, and S2 Galloping Tilt has 3–4 Base Power with +10/+12 Coin Power. Their power swings widely between Heads and Tails, so she tends to lose early on when SP is low. Her Defense Level is a low Identity Lv -2.
messages.S3「正義のため！」: コイン3枚(マッチ威力3〜12)で、マッチの主力。Ⅰ・Ⅱ: **S3 — For Justice!**: 3 Coins (Clash Power 3–12) and her main Clash skill. Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ inflict 1 Bleed on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅲ inflicts 2 Bleed Count on hit; the Bleed infliction is added at Uptie Ⅳ.
messages.マッチ勝利で自己強化: マッチ勝利時に、S1は次のターンにクイック1/2、S2は: **Self-buffs on Clash Win**: On Clash Win, S1 grants 1/2 Haste next turn, and S2 grants 1/2 Attack Power Up next turn. S2's Coin Ⅰ also inflicts 2 Bleed on Heads Hit, added at Uptie Ⅳ.
messages.S3の速度条件: 速度10以上でコイン威力+2。自分の速度は最大6で、S1のクイ: **S3's Speed condition**: +2 Coin Power at 10 or more Speed. Her own Speed tops out at 6, and even adding S1's Haste (up to 2) only reaches 8. Meeting the condition requires Haste from other allies.
messages.バトルパッシブ「正義の成敗」(色欲×3・共鳴): マッチ勝利時、そのスキルの与ダ: **Combat passive — Righteous Retribution (3 Lust Resonance)**: On Clash Win, that skill deals +10% damage.
messages.サポートパッシブ「応援」(色欲×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が最も高い味: **Support passive — Support (5 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: The 1 ally with the highest SP deals +10% damage with Pierce skills.
messages.序盤は勝てそうな相手にだけS1・S2をぶつけてマッチ勝利の強化を取る。分の悪いマ: Early on, only throw S1 and S2 at opponents she can likely beat to collect the Clash Win buffs. Avoid unfavorable Clashes, use one-sided attacks instead, and build up her SP. Once her SP is high, take Clashes with S3 and, at Uptie Ⅳ, stack Bleed. In teams with Pierce attackers, leaving her in backup to use Support is also an option.
